name: Waxy Wash

features.text: Leaves a waxy feel on the surface
Thin enough for proportioner and tunnel use.

description: A high-foam shampoo that lifts and removes dirt, road-film, and other contaminants from vehicle exterior. Cleans without removing existing wax and leaves a rich, renewed wax-like shine.
application: Surface should be cool and out of direct sunlight. Dilute 2-4 oz. with each gallon of cold water. Wet vehicle thoroughly and apply Waxy Wash to entire vehicle with a wash mitt, sponge, or soft cloth. Rinse well and dry vehicle with a clean chamois or soft towel.
review: Has a Performance Ratings section: Foaming - 7 Concentration - 5
